findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: chat_validate, chat_render_video, chat_screenshot, reddit_render_video, reddit_screenshot · Private data: chat_validate, chat_render_video, chat_screenshot, reddit_render_video, reddit_screenshot · Public sink: reddit_render_video, reddit_screenshot · Destructive: chat_validate, chat_render_video, chat_screenshot, reddit_render_video, reddit_screenshot.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: chat_validate, chat_render_video, chat_screenshot, reddit_render_video, reddit_screenshot · Private data: chat_validate, chat_render_video, chat_screenshot, reddit_render_video, reddit_screenshot · Public sink: reddit_render_video, reddit_screenshot · Destructive: chat_validate, chat_render_video, chat_screenshot, reddit_render_video, reddit_screenshot

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
